source_package: EDUCATION wiki全内容/56-EDUCATION wiki全内容
coding_rule: Existing page IDs are preserved; activity-card filenames are matched by activity title, not by their B-number. HEART-Edu_Loop.docx supplies the page sequence.

activity_sources.activity_card: 2-活动卡片/H01_肺炎链球菌疫苗防护宣导_1_2_translate_20260904214916.docx
activity_sources.planning_goal: To enhance parents' understanding of respiratory health protection for infants and knowledge related to vaccines, and to provide a starting point for subsequent consultations.

activity_sources.activity_card: 2-活动卡片/H08_“给宝宝的第一份安全检测雷达”孕检候诊快闪_1_2_translate_20260904215138.docx
activity_sources.planning_goal: To introduce the project's research focus and baseline respiratory health data in a low-intrusive, contactless manner, while listening to the real-life concerns of pregnant families.

activity_sources.activity_card: 2-活动卡片/H02_肺炎链球菌疫苗月子中心合作小课堂_1_2_translate_20260904215012.docx
activity_sources.planning_goal: To help staff provide more accurate and human-centered communication when addressing parents' questions.

activity_sources.activity_card: 2-活动卡片/H03_小手净净・健康同行——幼儿园七步洗手法健康科普教育_1_2_translate_20260904215021.docx
activity_sources.planning_goal: To encourage children to wash their hands willingly, to teach them the correct way to wash their hands, and to help them remember the key times to wash their hands.

activity_sources.activity_card: 2-活动卡片/H04_小手搭生命・模块化黏土工坊_1_2_translate_20260904215031.docx
activity_sources.planning_goal: To help children gain an initial understanding of bacteriophages, antibodies, and functional enzymes through modular creative activities.

activity_sources.activity_card: 2-活动卡片/H05_神奇的生物乐高：合成生物学大冒险_1_2_translate_20260904215040.docx
activity_sources.planning_goal: Use the "building with Lego" analogy to help children gain an initial understanding of DNA, the assembly of life components, and synthetic biology.

activity_sources.activity_card: 2-活动卡片/H06_《看得见的防护》——老年专属健康知识宣传_1_2_translate_20260904215051.docx
activity_sources.planning_goal: To convey basic safety precautions through large-print materials and straightforward explanations, while fostering emotional connection and health awareness through postcards.

activity_sources.activity_card: 2-活动卡片/H07_守护银发・基础防护规范培训_1_2_translate_20260904215129.docx
activity_sources.planning_goal: Translate key elements—such as hand hygiene, ventilation, cleaning, and documentation—into actionable care practices.

activity_sources.activity_card: 2-活动卡片/B01_呼吸的科学密码——手抄报校园巡展.docx
activity_sources.planning_goal: Enable students to understand basic concepts of respiratory protection and detection through hand-drawing, presentation and exhibition visits.

activity_sources.activity_card: 2-活动卡片/B02_“呼吸实验室”线上云课堂_1_3_translate_20260904215638.docx
activity_sources.planning_goal: Introduce basic concepts of respiratory health, biosensing and synthetic biology via story-based recorded courses.

activity_sources.activity_card: 2-活动卡片/B10_薪续白医红，科创润童心——葛公小学红色支教科普活动_1_2_translate_20260904214605.docx
activity_sources.planning_goal: To bridge modern synthetic biology with basic respiratory protection through local narratives of dedicated healthcare professionals, thereby integrating cultural understanding, scientific literacy, and health education.

activity_sources.activity_card: 2-活动卡片/B03_隐形的卫士：镜头下的生命与健康_1_2_translate_20260904215335.docx
activity_sources.planning_goal: Enable students to connect natural life, daily protection and synthetic biology through image creation.

activity_sources.activity_card: 2-活动卡片/B04_呼吸道检测小发明创意设计小课堂_1_3_translate_20260904215435.docx
activity_sources.planning_goal: Allow students to experience the design process from real-life pain points to conceptual sketches, and pay attention to the needs of diverse user groups.

activity_sources.activity_card: 2-活动卡片/B05_“解码生命・智竞未来”青少年合成生物学知识问答竞赛_1_3_translate_20260904215511.docx
activity_sources.planning_goal: Help students understand synthetic biology, respiratory detection and daily protection through tiered competition and error-review sessions.

activity_sources.activity_card: 2-活动卡片/B06_“合成生物学生态圈”未来职业研讨会_1_3_translate_20260904215528.docx
activity_sources.planning_goal: Demonstrate diverse professional roles required for translating health-related technologies from R&D to real-world application, and help students identify participation pathways matching their strengths.

activity_sources.activity_card: 2-活动卡片/B07_追光科创，逐梦归来——全国高中生返校公益宣讲_1_2_translate_20260904214406.docx
activity_sources.planning_goal: To bridge the fundamentals of synthetic biology, the insights gained from the iGEM competition, and the pathways for scientific and technological innovation exploration at the high school level through standardized, replicable public outreach events upon returning to school.

activity_sources.activity_card: 2-活动卡片/B08_百团纳新合成生物学科普摊位_1_2_translate_20260904214501.docx
activity_sources.planning_goal: To introduce synthetic biology, respiratory health, and team-based research themes in a high-traffic campus environment, and to gather frequently asked questions from students across various disciplines.

activity_sources.activity_card: 2-活动卡片/B09_晚风愈心绪・科创护呼吸——宿舍楼下 NPC 互动与合成生物轻科普活动_1_2_translate_20260904214523.docx
activity_sources.planning_goal: To provide non-clinical peer support and a platform for scientific dialogue, introducing basic protection measures and synthetic biology in a relatable, everyday context.

activity_sources.activity_card: 2-活动卡片/B11_奔跑逐光・以跑聚力——校园健康跑呼吸道健康科普活动_1_2_translate_20260904214621.docx
activity_sources.planning_goal: To understand the exercise-related respiratory health and family protection needs of young adults in a Health Run context, and to introduce basic care practices as well as research directions for related projects.

activity_sources.activity_card: 2-活动卡片/B13_杏花文化节合成生物学科普摊位_1_2_translate_20260904214743.docx
activity_sources.planning_goal: Leverage springtime outdoor exhibition opportunities to use a layered instructional approach to lower the barrier to understanding in synthetic biology and detection technologies.

activity_sources.activity_card: 2-活动卡片/B12_呼吸道病原检测方式选择——草地音乐节开放场互动投票科普活动_1_2_translate_20260904214732.docx
activity_sources.planning_goal: To help the public understand the appropriate use cases for different testing methods through voting and comparative demonstrations, while gathering actual user preferences.

activity_sources.activity_card: 2-活动卡片/B14_《植物大战僵尸：基因战争》游戏化合成生物学科普企划_1_2_translate_20260904214804.docx
activity_sources.planning_goal: Use a boundary-based game analogy to introduce concepts such as CRISPR, RNA interference, drug resistance, biofilms, and immune evasion.

activity_sources.activity_card: 2-活动卡片/D01_以艺术疗愈温暖“星星的孩子”——非遗漆扇志愿服务活动_1_2_translate_20260904214854.docx
activity_sources.planning_goal: Use the traditional craft of making lacquer fans as a medium to convey basic hygiene and respiratory protection information through low-stimulation interactions.

activity_sources.activity_card: 2-活动卡片/D02_伴“星”成长，为“星”筑梦——爱徒步・融未来特需青少年社会融合徒步科普活动_1_2_translate_20260904214906.docx
activity_sources.planning_goal: To use a joint hiking activity as a platform to integrate health protection, basic safety measures, accessible science outreach on synthetic biology, and social inclusion.
